composition.notes: See source template and component guide for projection slots.

usage.summary: `good-group` collects related content without the visual weight of a Card. It owns padding and a 16 px gap between projected children. Paragraphs and controls contribute no outer spacing, so a paragraph, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Select, or FormRow can be substituted without doubling that gap. Checkbox and radio choices retain 44 px touch targets inside their own bounds. `appearance="outline"` (default) draws a quiet border and places an optional title in that border; `contrast` uses a soft theme-aware background; `plain` keeps the spacing with no surface. Set `title` to label the native `section`. `headingLevel` defaults to 2 and accepts 2, 3, or 4 so heading order remains correct. `headingId` can be set when a page needs a stable external reference. The title is omitted completely when empty.
